controller: WinMax Mill 10.4.0.32407 DC (DS Desktop simulator, VMX42SRTi)
description: WinMax 'courses' = named, ordered, VISION-FREE step-sequences that drive the WinMax GUI through each production phase (load program, define tools, set offsets, verify). A course composes the primitives the runner (scripts/winmax-course-run.mjs) knows how to execute against PrismWinMaxUI.exe (UIA driver) + winmax-ui-map.json (FSM navigation). Steps are deterministic: no screenshot/vision is used at runtime — navigation is FSM-key emission, field read/write is UIA by AutomationId. This is the 'plot out your courses to successful step' deliverable; proven courses become the replayable spine of the closed-loop self-test harness. slot:echo.

facts.unitsAreInch: The PRISM base job + RICH NC declare G20 (inch). A 25.4x mislabel is the #1 catastrophic error — every diameter/length below is INCH.
facts.undefinedToolsNonBlocking: WinMax Mill User Guide p99: a tool used in the NC program but not defined in Tool Setup renders in Tool Review as an unknown tool (diameter 0, unknown location) — it does NOT block Draw/verify. So a graphics-verify course does NOT require T1-T4 to be defined first.
facts.verifyTrigger: User Guide p459-460: 'View the part using the Draw console key to verify that the part is programmed correctly.' Draw is a console key; its DS-Desktop keyboard/toolbar binding is the one unresolved leaf (see course verify-program step 'draw-trigger').
facts.fieldInputRecipe: Numeric fields accept digits ONLY in edit mode, entered by a CLICK. Proven recipe per field: click <id> -> type-raw '<digits>' -> type-raw '{ENTER}'. {ENTER} commits + advances. In the add-tool GEOMETRY form commit with {TAB} not {ENTER} (ENTER = save+exit, fires before value commits).
facts.softkeyCollision: Softkey Buttons (ids 301-308) collide with data-field Edit ids on the same screen. The driver's Locate is Edit-preferred for data ops; softkeys are actuated by sendkeys '{Fn}', never by id-invoke.

primitives.nav: Navigate FSM map from current screen to args.to via winmax-ui-map.mjs shortestPath; runner emits each transition key with sendkeys. Re-fingerprints (whereami) after to confirm arrival.
primitives.field: Proven field recipe: click args.id -> type-raw args.value -> type-raw (args.commit||'{ENTER}'). args.commit='{TAB}' on geometry forms.
primitives.assert: get-text args.id; PASS iff value === args.equals (or matches args.matches regex). Records actual.
primitives.fingerprint: probe -> winmax-ui-map.mjs whereami; logs matched screen (or null + signature for map-gap discovery).

verify-program.goal: Run a graphics verify (Draw) of the currently-loaded ISNC program and read the result. Does NOT require tools defined (undefinedToolsNonBlocking).
preconditions: An NC program is loaded in the ISNC editor (see course load-program).

steps.text: Undefined tools render as unknown (dia 0) and do NOT block Draw. We verify program correctness, not tool geometry, here.

steps.note: Ensure we are at the editor where the program buffer lives.

candidates: one-time coordinate calibration of the DS toolbar Draw button (CONFIRMED path: toolbar buttons are NOT in the UIA accessibility tree — no Name, no HelpText tooltip; only a single coord-readout button exposes text. So this is a genuine vision touch-point, identified ONCE then click-xy forever on the fixed-layout maximized window)
a DS keyboard accelerator for Draw (search CHM/manual)
a Part Programming / DRAW softkey on a not-yet-mapped conversational screen
steps.note: The single unresolved leaf, and a GENUINE vision boundary (not a mapping gap): WinMax DS draws the console-key toolbar graphically with no UIA tooltip (verified 2026-05-31 after adding HelpText extraction — find 'draw' returns []). Resolve by one-time visual id of the Draw button coordinate, then click-xy; OR a keyboard accelerator if the manual documents one.

Status line is GRAPHICAL (UIA value empty) — graphics verdict likely needs the rendered graphics window, not this pane. Honest gap: verify PASS/FAIL read may require the one genuine vision touch-point.

define-tool.goal: Define one per-program tool (TOOL SETUP form) with diameter + calibrated length, then save. Proven recipe; TYPE dropdown is optional for verify.

May report null if the database-list variant is overlaid (signature has 329/332 + hasList) — known map gap.
Confirm diameter committed. Numeric compare: WinMax pads to 4 decimals (2.0 -> '2.0000'), valuesMatch parses both sides as numbers.

gaps: PROGRAM_MANAGER screen (INPUT_MENU F8) not yet mapped — file-open dialog flow unknown.

gaps: WORK_OFFSETS form (PART_SETUP F1) not yet mapped — field ids unknown.
